g.text: Channel 0 is armed for tick 111,242 by a CMP0 write over serial: arm_time carries it and arm_we is high. The -1 makes 111,241, and the multiplexer
steers it into the deadline register at this clock edge. reached is already 1, against the register's reset value, but armed is 0, so the AND gate
The register holds 111,241 and armed is 1. now - (deadline - 1) = -17,023: negative, so reached is 0. From here the same subtraction runs on every
clock, and nothing outside the timing unit takes part.
now = 111,237. now - (deadline - 1) = -4: still negative, reached stays 0 and the pin stays low.
now = 111,238. now - (deadline - 1) = -3: still negative, reached stays 0 and the pin stays low.
now = 111,239. now - (deadline - 1) = -2: still negative, reached stays 0 and the pin stays low.
now = 111,240. now - (deadline - 1) = -1: still negative, reached stays 0 and the pin stays low.
now = 111,241 = deadline - 1. The difference is 0, so reached rises, and with armed at 1 the AND gate raises fire. Nothing has moved yet: fire is a
wire, and the clock edge has not come.
The clock edge. The counter loads pw = 8 and armed clears. The counter is not zero, so TRIG0 on uo_out[0] goes high on this clock, when now = 111,242:
The counter counts down to 7. TRIG0 stays high; reached is still 1, but armed is 0, so fire stays low.
The counter counts down to 6. TRIG0 stays high; reached is still 1, but armed is 0, so fire stays low.
The counter counts down to 5. TRIG0 stays high; reached is still 1, but armed is 0, so fire stays low.
The counter counts down to 4. TRIG0 stays high; reached is still 1, but armed is 0, so fire stays low.
The counter counts down to 3. TRIG0 stays high; reached is still 1, but armed is 0, so fire stays low.
The counter counts down to 2. TRIG0 stays high; reached is still 1, but armed is 0, so fire stays low.
The counter counts down to 1. TRIG0 stays high; reached is still 1, but armed is 0, so fire stays low.
The counter reaches 0 and TRIG0 falls: a pulse of exactly 8 clocks. reached stays 1, since the deadline is now in the past, but armed is 0, so nothing
Idle: TRIG0 is low and the channel waits to be armed again.
Idle: TRIG0 is low and the channel waits to be armed again.
